title: Group B & Group C     – 1484 Posts
qualification: M.Sc. (Home Science Food & Nutrition / Clinical Nutrition / Food Science & Nutrition / Food Service Management & Dietetics) + 3 years' experience in a 200-bed hospital
salary: Pay scales follow the 7th Pay Commission Pay Matrix. Specific pay levels differ by post and institute. || In addition to basic pay, posts carry allowances (HRA, DA, TA, etc.) as per the rules applicable at each respective institute.
age_limit: Age limits are post-specific and measured as of the closing date of online registration, i.e., 30 June 2026 . Most Group B posts cap at age 30 years and Group C posts cap between 18–30 years , though higher caps apply to some technical and supervisory roles (up to 35 or 40 years). Candidates wondering about age relaxation can note the following: || Note: SC/ST/OBC candidates applying for unreserved vacancies are not entitled to age relaxation. AIIMS New Delhi, AIIMS-CAPFIMS, LHMC & associated hospitals, ICMR, and Pasteur Institute of India follow Central Government service conditions only for the age relaxation benefit to existing employees.
application_fee: The application fee is charged per group applied. Candidates applying to multiple groups must pay separately for each group.
selection_process: CRE-5 follows a multi-stage recruitment process. Each stage is mandatory for progression to the next. || Stage 1 - Online Application: Candidates register on www.aiimsexams.ac.in and submit applications by 30 June 2026. || Stage 2 - Application Acceptance: Application status published on 9 July 2026. || Stage 3 - Computer Based Test (CBT): Tentatively 25–27 July 2026 at examination centres across major states/UTs of India. || Stage 4 - Skill Test (where applicable): Conducted after CBT for qualifying candidates in applicable groups. Venue: preferably Delhi/NCR. Date to be notified. || Stage 5 - Choice & Preference: Qualified candidates are invited to exercise institute choices and indicate order of preference. Candidates who fail to exercise choices within the given period will not be considered for any institute. || Stage 6 - Seat Allocation: Allocation is made in order of merit based on choices exercised and eligibility at each participating institute. || Stage 7 - Document Verification: Original certificates verified by the respective AIIMS/Institute on the date notified by them.

title: Scientist, Assistant Engineer and More     – 538 Posts
qualification: M.Sc. in Botany/Zoology/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Physical Anthropology/Genetics/Forensic Science (with Botany or Zoology at B.Sc.) or B.E./B.Tech Biotechnology
salary: All pay scales are as per the 7th Central Pay Commission Pay Matrix . The level assigned to each post determines the salary band. Key pay levels across these 70 posts are listed below. || The probation period is 2 years for Group B posts including Junior Scientific Officer (NCONF), Assistant Engineer (Civil) NEC, Sr. Scientific Assistants (DGAQA), Botanist (BSI), Scientist 'B' (CFSL), Research Officer (Map) ORGI, Asst. Director Grade-II MSME, and all UT Ladakh posts unless otherwise noted. The probation period is 1 year for most Group A posts. For posts under ORGI, the National Pension System (NPS) is applicable with effect from 01.01.2004, and the Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) is applicable with effect from 01.04.2025; candidates eligible for NPS have the option to enrol directly under UPS on joining.
age_limit: The standard age relaxations applicable to these posts are as follows. SC candidates receive 5 additional years, OBC candidates receive 3 additional years, and all PwBD candidates receive 10 additional years over and above their category relaxation. For certain posts with a base upper limit of 50 years, the PwBD maximum is capped at 56 years - this applies to the Regional Director (NCONF), Professor Sugar Engineering (NSI), Principal (A&N), and Consultant Ophthalmologist (UT Ladakh). UPSC may relax qualifications and experience at its discretion in writing for candidates otherwise well qualified.

title: Project Engineer, Project Manager and More     – 951 Posts
qualification: ITI/NCVT Trade Certificate with 6 years; OR Diploma in Engg. with 1 year; OR Graduate in CS/Electronics/IT with 1 year; OR DOEACC 'O' Level with 5 years; OR DOEACC 'A' Level with 4 years
salary: 5 years (in addition to other applicable relaxations)
age_limit: The upper age limit for C-DAC JIT June 2026 posts is calculated as on 20 June 2026 . Age relaxation is available to SC/ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), PwBD, Ex-Servicemen, and Government employees as per Government of India norms.
application_fee: C-DAC charges no application fee for any position under the JIT June 2026 Recruitment Cycle. This applies to all candidates across all categories — General, EWS, OBC, SC, ST, and PwBD — and across all 11 centres. No payment of any kind is required at any stage of the application process.
selection_process: C-DAC follows a multi-stage selection process for JIT June 2026 positions. All communications regarding selection stages are sent by email only — no hard copy letters or call letters are dispatched at any stage. || Stage 1 – Initial Academic Screening: All submitted applications are assessed on the basis of academic records, qualifications, declared experience, and domain relevance. Only candidates meeting minimum eligibility criteria proceed further. C-DAC reserves the right to raise the minimum cut-off if the applicant volume significantly exceeds the number of vacancies. || Stage 2 – Written Test (if applicable): A written or skill-based test may be conducted at the discretion of individual centres, depending on the number of screened-in candidates. Shortlisted candidates will be notified by email. No TA/DA is paid for attending the written test. || Stage 3 – Personal Interview: Candidates who clear the screening and written test stages are called for a personal interview by the respective C-DAC centre. The interview call is sent by email only. Receipt of an interview call letter does not confirm selection. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.
